admission.justification: mcp/src/agents_remember/package_data/paseo_plugin/client/start.ts and client/bridge.ts enforce paired parent/frame origins and parent window identity, dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameControl.ts checks the frame window/origin, and PaseoChatFrame.tsx scopes clipboard policy to that origin, preventing an unlisted parent or lookalike window from steering chat or receiving delegated browser policy.

applicability: Dashboard and canonical plugin web control traffic for the frame descriptor's configured http(s) serving origin.
conditions: A new parent is trusted only after the current embed list confirms its exact dashboard/frame origin pair.
Same-page reevaluation may reuse that page's already verified parent while rechecking the list.
exclusions: An unknown parent or failed first list read establishes no new trust.
Browser clipboard policy delegation is not proof of a clipboard operation or user permission grant.
Unsupported web framing/DOM behavior and a successful refreshed trust check remain version-sensitive.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoPluginClient.test.ts::listed frame: the AR look and the channel, once the list has confirmed the parent; dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoPluginClient.test.ts::takes a message only from the parent's origin and the parent's own window; dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoPluginClient.test.ts::evaluated again in the same page: no gap in the channel, and the list has the last word; dashboard/src/cockpit/PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx::ignores messages from another origin or another window; dashboard/e2e/cockpit.spec.ts::Role chats receives clipboard Permissions Policy in its cross-origin frame

origin.handoffEntry: PNT-R05@v3 / paired embed trust and origin clipboard policy

statement: A newly trusted embedded page requires the exact dashboard/frame origin pair, control traffic requires the corresponding exact window and origin on both sides, and the dashboard delegates clipboard policy only to the embedded origin.
